description: This file defines the MailStats class, which manages email statistics data within the Goteo project. It handles fetching, updating, and validating statistics related to email metrics, including tracking counts and incrementing metrics.

classes.name: MailStats
classes.description: A class responsible for handling email statistics records, including retrieval, incrementation, and validation of metrics related to email interactions.

methods.name: getMetric
methods.description: Retrieves the metric associated with the current MailStats instance.

methods.name: inc
methods.description: Increments the counter of email statistics by one.

methods.name: getStat
methods.description: Fetches a mail statistics record based on mail ID, email, and metric, creating a new record if none exists and auto_create is true.

methods.name: getFromMailId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of MailStats objects for a specific mail ID, optionally counting or paginating results.

methods.name: incMetric
methods.description: Increments a specific metric for a mail and email, creating the stat if necessary and handling errors.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current MailStats object to the database after validation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the MailStats data, ensuring essential fields are filled.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Provides a list of MailStats objects or a count related to the current mail object.
